entities.summary: Don Quixote was a seminal 1605 novel by Miguel de Cervantes, born in Madrid, Spain, and died in Mequinenza, Aragon, Spain. This masterpiece tells the story of Alonso Quixano, a nobleman who renounces his title and wealth to live a life of chivalry and adventure. Through his protagonist's quest for honor and his misadventures with reality, Cervantes skewers the romantic ideals of chivalry and offers a scathing critique of the societal norms of his time. Don Quixote's impact on literature is immeasurable, influencing the development of the modern novel and inspiring countless adaptations and interpretations. The novel's exploration of identity, reality, and the human condition continues to resonate with readers today.
